_comment: What scripts/setup_langfuse.py creates in a Langfuse project. Names must match what the code sends (tracing.py, guardrail checks). Edit this file, not the script.

score_configs.name: guardrail
score_configs.description: The guardrail's decision for the turn. No score for a fixed reply (nothing was checked).

score_configs.name: guardrail_grounding
score_configs.description: How well the retrieved content supports the answer (guardrail grounding check). Low values suggest an unsupported answer.

score_configs.name: guardrail_relevance
score_configs.description: How relevant the answer is to the search (guardrail relevance check).

score_configs.name: first_status_ms
score_configs.description: Milliseconds from the question to the first status event (visible feedback).

score_configs.name: first_token_ms
score_configs.description: Milliseconds from the question to the first answer token.

score_configs.name: total_ms
score_configs.description: Milliseconds from the question to the end of the answer.

score_configs.name: user_feedback
score_configs.description: Thumbs up (true) or down (false) from the user, once the front end sends it.

score_configs.name: review
score_configs.description: A reviewer's verdict on an answer, for annotation queues.

dashboards.name: Assistant health
dashboards.description: Created by scripts/setup_langfuse.py. Speed, guardrail decisions and grounding.

widgets.name: Total answer time (ms), p50 and p95
Model calls, p95 latency by model

manual_steps: Protect the production prompt label (project settings, prompt management; plan permitting), so only named people can promote a prompt.
Create one API key pair per environment (local, test, production) and store them in the environment's secret store, never in the repo.
Set data retention for traces deliberately (project settings), in line with the data-residency decision.
Add project members with the least role they need; reviewers as annotators.
Seed the prompts: .venv/bin/python scripts/push_prompts.py (creates only the prompts Langfuse lacks).
Open the dashboard once real traces exist and check each widget shows data; adjust deploy/langfuse-setup.json if a field name has changed.
Grounding p10: the API offers no p10 aggregation; add it in the UI if wanted.
